meta.title: Russia in Winter · CEIBS classmates · January 2027
meta.description: A private winter journey for CEIBS classmates. January 24–31, 2027: Moscow, Teriberka, and St. Petersburg. Final registration.

hero.eyebrow: A private journey for CEIBS classmates
hero.imageAlt: Red Square and Saint Basil’s Cathedral under snow, Moscow

tracks.title: Come for one reason. Stay for the others.
tracks.intro: Mix the tracks. Most people do.

items.title: Business
items.text: Tell us your business interest, and we will arrange private meetings and company visits for you. Moscow and St. Petersburg, with optional extra days February 1–3.

items.title: Education
items.text: SKOLKOVO, Russia’s leading business school, plus a lecture on doing business in Russia and meetings with top tech companies like Yandex and Sber.

items.title: Culture
items.text: The Kremlin under snow, the Hermitage, the palaces of St. Petersburg, and a Moscow night out.

items.title: Unique
items.text: One day at the edge of the Arctic: Teriberka, sled rides, the Barents Sea, and sea urchins and scallops eaten minutes after a diver brings them up.

tracks.campusAlt: Four frames left to right: a T-Bank office, the SKOLKOVO campus, the ice rink at VDNKh, and a whale fluke in Arctic waters
tracks.campusCaption: T-Bank, SKOLKOVO, the VDNKh ice rink, and the Arctic — one week.

why.title: Why Russia, why winter
why.imageAlt: A winter folk festival in the snow, with wooden towers and a crowd in traditional dress

points.title: Winter, unfiltered
points.text: Snow-covered cities, holiday lights, warm restaurants, and a Russian banya. Russian soul, winter colour, the world’s best cuisine, business and technology — what you will not find anywhere else.

points.title: Warmer than the rumour
points.text: January sits around −6 °C in Moscow, −5 °C in St. Petersburg, and −10 to −20 °C in Murmansk and Teriberka. The Barents Sea stays open thanks to the Gulf Stream. We send a warm-clothing checklist before you fly.

points.title: Lights, and daylight
points.text: It is northern-lights season. The polar night is already over, so the Arctic still has daylight.

points.title: Three Russias, one week
points.text: The business capital, the Arctic, and the imperial capital.

why.visa: Visa-free entry for Chinese citizens, valid through 31 December 2027. Other nationalities: the organizers help with an e-visa.

finalForm.title: Confirm your participation
finalForm.intro: Add passport details for yourself and everyone accompanying you, then share your group’s travel plans.
finalForm.requiredNote: Fields marked * are required. Phone and WeChat are optional.
finalForm.sessionNote: Your entries and selected files stay in this tab until submission. Do not refresh or change language while completing the form.
finalForm.reviewReady: Private test: the workbook and scans are sent to Vladislav only. Public registration is not yet open. Please use test documents.
finalForm.unavailable: Final registration is temporarily unavailable. You can view the form, but cannot submit yet. Please contact the organizers or return later.
finalForm.fullName: Full name exactly as in passport
finalForm.fileHint: One readable JPEG, PNG or PDF per person, up to 10 MiB (10,485,760 bytes). No encrypted or password-protected PDFs.
finalForm.groupTravel: One arrival and one departure for your whole group. Enter local time in the arrival/departure city; extended stays are welcome.
finalForm.singleRoom: Do you need a single room? (solo participants only)
finalForm.paymentNote: This only records your preferred method. No payment is collected here.
finalForm.privacy: Organizers Vladislav and Olga use the names and passport scans to arrange domestic flights and hotels. Copies are sent to each organizer in personal Telegram messages. Server-held copies are deleted on March 2, 2027 at 00:00 UTC; this does not delete Telegram copies held by the recipients.
finalForm.consent: I consent to this use and forwarding of my information and documents. I confirm I am authorized to provide every accompanying person’s information and documents and have obtained their consent (or the consent of their legal representative).
finalForm.successBody: The organizers’ private notifications are queued. No payment has been taken.
